pages.text: Karolina York | karolina york print studio Loading... Weekly Print Drops. Every Monday. Home Our World About Meet the Team Trade Shows Social Press Contact Contact Careers Services Buyers Portal prev ">next As Seen On prev ">next At Karolina York, we are proud to work with clients across Australia and around the world — travelling interstate and overseas each month to showcase our collection in person. Our collection is known for our fresh take on timeless styles, ranging from feminine florals to free-spirited bohemian prints and elevated conversationals. What truly sets us apart is our in-house studio, where every design is thoughtfully crafted, giving us the flexibility and creativity to deliver truly unique collections. Drawing inspiration from our Australian lifestyle and informed by global trends, our talented design team creates a distinctive range of prints that cater to the evolving needs of the modern, international market. With our headquarters in Sydney and a strong global presence, our team is always on the move. Our Services Signature Designs Bespoke Designs Service Work & Exclusive Artworks Signature Designs Global exclusive designs selected from our trend driven and innovative collection. Designs come in repeat, object layers and/or colour separation. Shop Now Bespoke Designs The designers at Karolina York work to your specific brief, creating custom commissioned artwork to achieve exactly what you desire. Requesting a lead time of 5-10 working days, we offer the following services: 1 X Artwork, Designed In Full Repeat 2 X Rounds Of Comments And Amendments Consultation With Senior Designer Silk Swatch Of Your Artwork Artwork File. Psd - Rgb, 250 Dpi Starting From $980 + Gst - Contact us for a quote Contact Us Service Work & Exclusive Artworks The designers at Karolina York can accommodate your needs by making modifications to our core collection designs. Let us take an existing print and adjust it to perfectly fit your vision. Choose from the following services: Colour Separation & Base Colour Change Artwork Modification Colour & Scale Modifications Creative Consultations File Resend Exclusive Artworks Swatch Reprinting Additional Colourway Printing Contact Us Our Clients Trusted by over 400 retailers and brands globally we are proud to work with... prev ">next What our customers say It is real that your videos are great!!! Such a lot of pretty prints. What a wonderful collection! Diego Silvestre Women Secret Just have to tell you that your print book is the most beautiful thing I have ever seen!!! You guys are incredible! Katelyn Perrotti Ikeddi As a design team we love to look through the print book – the illustrations always make the prints come alive and give us so much inspiration! Sarah is such a great person to work with too, always on hand with beautiful print suggestions that she knows will work across our brands. Looking forward to seeing the new collection soon! Emily Robert Influence Manchester I am a Karolina York super fan, their collections are fantastic and their files are the best around to work with Anonymous We have worked with Bron and her team for many years now. The team is always so happy, friendly and welcoming and always going above and beyond. The team is so creative and their prints are unlike any others - they are truly unique and we love them. Ashlea Holdsworth The Upside I have both purchased and developed some magnificent prints for my business that always take the brand to the next level. Anonymous Karolina York has an amazing design team that provides a varied and unusual print offering for a newness in a sea of same. Anonymous Not only are Karolina York's prints beautiful, but their files come in repeat and are always of high quality which makes working with their designs really easy. We love receiving their trend newsletters and the flip book with their latest work is a joy to look through Rebecca Cooper Next Menswear I've been working with Karolina York now for years

Home Our World About Meet the Team Trade Shows Social Press Contact Contact Careers Services Buyers Portal Our Studio Services Signature Collection Our Signature Collection is a library of exclusive surface prints, crafted by our in-house design team to capture seasonal trends while remaining timeless. Each design reflects our studio’s dedication to originality, craft, and the evolving needs of brands. Our Signature Collection represents the many designers that make Karolina York studio so distinctive. Custom Artwork Custom artwork refers to an original print design created by Karolina York’s designers in response to a client’s specific brief. These designs are bespoke and commissioned, developed with your input and tailored to your creative and commercial objectives. 1 X Artwork, Designed In Full Repeat 2 X Rounds Of Comments And Amendments Consultation With Senior Designer Silk Swatch Of Your Artwork Artwork File. Psd - Rgb, 250 Dpi We also offer artwork modifications if additional adjustments are needed. Contact Us This site uses cookies. By using KarolinaYork.com, you accept our privacy policy . Shop Online Book an Appointment Custom Artwork Contact Us The Company Home About Press Contact Careers Ways to Shop Online Shop Design Services Print Showings Tradeshows Sign up to our newsletter to immerse yourself in design inspiration, trend reports and new collection releases. Subscribe Karolina York acknowledges the connection to land, sea and community of the Cammeraygal people, the traditional custodians on whose lands our head office is located. We acknowledge this land has always been a place of making and creativity and pay our respects to elders past and present. We extend this respect to all Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people today. Privacy policy This site uses cookies. By using KarolinaYork.com, you accept our privacy policy .
